# Proposal: Publication-Grade Live Agent Tracker (`agent-tracker`)

## Why
As AI coding agents (such as Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and multi-agent teams) perform complex, multi-step engineering tasks, developers lack high-fidelity, real-time visibility into what agents are doing under the hood. Existing tools (like terminal session monitors or disconnected TUIs) suffer from severe limitations:
1. **Passive & Disconnected Tracking**: Current monitors either require manual refreshes or push synthetic mocks; they fail to actively tail live agent conversation transcripts (`transcript.jsonl`), leaving users blind to live reasoning and tool execution states.
2. **Multi-Agent & Subagent Blindspot**: Modern autonomous workflows spawn subagents, background bash commands, and parallel tasks. Existing trackers display flat logs, completely losing track of subagent hierarchies, task delegation, and parent-child dependencies.
3. **Opaque Tool Execution & Zero Diff Previews**: When an agent edits files, developers only see generic notifications without instant visual syntax-highlighted diffs, ANSI terminal stdout streams, or live execution timers.
4. **Context Window & Cost Opacity**: As sessions progress, users have no real-time gauge of context window saturation, token velocity, or cost accumulation.

Building a dedicated, publication-grade **Agent Tracker** (`agent-tracker`) within `html-report` bridges the live agent execution loop with a real-time reactive web dashboard on `localhost:3000`, transforming agent activity into an interactive, observable command center.

## What Changes
1. **Live Transcript Tailer & Streamer Engine (`agent-tracker.mjs`)**:
   - Provide an active, zero-config live watcher daemon that auto-discovers and tails active agent transcripts (such as `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl` and subagent logs).
   - Ingests streaming steps (`USER_INPUT`, `PLANNER_RESPONSE`, `thinking`, `tool_calls`) in real-time, parsing arguments, timing, and stdout chunks.
   - Pushes live Datastar SSE fragments to the dev server (`/__datastar_stream__`) with zero latency.
2. **Multi-Agent Hierarchy & Swarm Topology**:
   - Displays real-time hierarchical tree and swimlanes for orchestrator agents and subagents (`invoke_subagent`).
   - Tracks active status: `Thinking` (purple), `Executing Tool` (blue), `Waiting on User` (amber), `Idle/Completed` (emerald), `Error` (rose).
3. **Interactive Tool Execution & Live Diff Inspector**:
   - Rich DaisyUI cards for all tool types (`run_command`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `invoke_subagent`, `ask_question`).
   - Live elapsed stopwatch timer during execution.
   - Embedded unified/split diff viewer for code modifications.
   - ANSI-colored terminal drawer (`mockup-code`) for stdout/stderr logs.
4. **Context Window, Token Velocity & Health Gauges**:
   - Radial gauges and progress bars for context window utilization (e.g. tokens used vs limit).
   - Real-time token breakdown (Thinking tokens vs Completion tokens vs Input context).
   - Activity rate chart (Chart.js) showing tool calls and token velocity over time.
5. **Human-in-the-Loop Controls & Audio Notifications**:
   - Filter by agent, tool category, or status.
   - Audible and visual alert toggle when an agent requires user input or encounters an error.
   - Playback & pause controls for historical session replay.
   - Export full session as a standalone, self-contained HTML report.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `agent-tracker`: Real-time multi-agent activity monitoring, transcript tailing daemon, interactive tool execution inspector, subagent swarm hierarchy, and context/token telemetry dashboard.

### Modified Capabilities
- `live-llm-tracking`: Extend baseline LLM tracking to support active transcript file streaming, subagent event routing, and rich code diff payload structures.

## Impact
- **Runtime Scripts**: Enhances `skills/html-report/scripts/serve-report.mjs` and adds `skills/html-report/scripts/agent-tracker.mjs` (CLI live watcher and streamer).
- **Core Library**: Updates `skills/html-report/scripts/datastar-sse.mjs` with subagent swarm tracking models, transcript tailer adapters, and diff formatting helpers.
- **Reports & Dev Server**: Live dashboard embedded in companion reports (`index.html`) and workspace dev server (`implementation-progress.html` on `localhost:3000`).
- **Dependencies**: Uses existing zero-dependency Node.js SSE engine and lightweight CDN stack (Datastar.js, DaisyUI, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Chart.js).

# Design: Publication-Grade Live Agent Tracker (`agent-tracker`)

## Context
See [proposal.md](proposal.md) for background and motivation. The system already possesses a lightweight Datastar.js hypermedia engine (`datastar-sse.mjs`), dev server SSE routing (`serve-report.mjs`), and an in-browser Showdown markdown viewer. However, existing agent trackers (and previous mock streamers) lack active transcript tailing, multi-agent swarm hierarchy tracking, syntax-highlighted tool diffs, and context window saturation gauges.

## Architecture Overview
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph AgentRuntime["Autonomous Agent Runtime & Storage"]
        AgentSession["Active Agent Session\n(Google Antigravity / Claude Code / Codex)"]
        SubagentSession["Subagents (invoke_subagent)\n(Researcher, Coder, Reviewer)"]
        TranscriptDir["<appDataDir>/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/"]
        JSONLLog["transcript.jsonl / transcript_full.jsonl"]
        
        AgentSession -->|writes steps| JSONLLog
        SubagentSession -->|writes child steps| JSONLLog
        JSONLLog --> TranscriptDir
    end

    subgraph Daemon["Live Agent Tracker Daemon (agent-tracker.mjs)"]
        Watcher["File Watcher & Byte-Offset Tracker\n(fs.watch + readline cursor)"]
        TranscriptDir --> Watcher
        Parser["Step Parser & Tool Call Normalizer"]
        Watcher --> Parser
        DiffGen["Diff Generator & ANSI Highlighter"]
        Parser --> DiffGen
        SwarmRouter["Swarm State Machine & Hierarchy Engine"]
        Parser --> SwarmRouter
        SSEPublisher["SSE Publisher\n(POST /__datastar_stream__)"]
        SwarmRouter --> SSEPublisher
        DiffGen --> SSEPublisher
    end

    subgraph DevServer["Dev Server (serve-report.mjs)"]
        SSEHub["SSE Hub & Change Resolver\n(/__datastar_stream__)"]
        SSEPublisher -->|POST SSE Chunks| SSEHub
        DocResolver["OpenSpec Artifact MIME Resolver\n(.md -> text/markdown)"]
    end

    subgraph Browser["Browser Dashboard (localhost:3000)"]
        DSClient["Datastar.js Runtime\n(@starfederation/datastar)"]
        SSEHub -->|text/event-stream| DSClient
        
        subgraph UI["Reactive Hypermedia Components"]
            SwarmTree["#agent-swarm-hierarchy\n(Orchestrator & Subagent Cards)"]
            CoTStream["#agent-thought-stream\n(Real-Time Chain-of-Thought)"]
            ToolFeed["#tool-call-feed\n(Live Timers, Diffs & Terminal Drawers)"]
            ContextGauges["#context-telemetry\n(Token Velocity & Saturation Radial)"]
            AttentionBadge["#human-attention-banner\n(Chime & Question Prompts)"]
        end

        DSClient --> SwarmTree
        DSClient --> CoTStream
        DSClient --> ToolFeed
        DSClient --> ContextGauges
        DSClient --> AttentionBadge
    end
```

## Goals / Non-Goals

**Goals:**
- Provide a robust live tailing daemon (`agent-tracker.mjs`) that can tail any active agent conversation transcript with sub-100ms latency.
- Support multi-agent hierarchies (`invoke_subagent`), distinguishing root orchestrators from subagents with visual badges, dedicated thought streams, and parent-child links.
- Render rich tool execution cards with live elapsed timers, syntax-highlighted code diffs (`edit_file`, `write_file`), and ANSI terminal outputs.
- Display context window saturation gauges and token velocity tracking.
- Provide human-in-the-loop attention indicators and audible alerts when an agent enters `Waiting on User` or `Error`.
- Ensure zero new npm runtime dependencies (pure Node.js standard library + CDN stack).

**Non-Goals:**
- Replacing agent CLI binaries or intercepting system-level syscalls directly.
- Modifying host credentials or proprietary agent protocols.
- Building a full single-page application (SPA) with webpack/vite—Datastar ESM + DaisyUI CDN handles all hypermedia updates natively.

## Decisions

### Decision 1: Byte-Offset Incremental JSONL Tailing vs Full Polling
- **Choice**: Track file byte offset using Node `fs.openSync` and read only new appended bytes on `fs.watch` file change events.
- **Rationale**: Agent conversation logs (`transcript.jsonl` and `transcript_full.jsonl`) can grow to several megabytes. Re-reading and re-parsing the entire file on every step wastes CPU and introduces noticeable lag. Incremental streaming ensures sub-10ms event processing.
- **Alternatives Considered**: Polling `transcript.jsonl` every 1 second (too laggy, missed sub-second tool steps); hooking agent memory directly (infeasible across different LLM runners).

### Decision 2: In-Browser Diff Rendering via Lightweight CDN or Pre-Computed Diffs
- **Choice**: Compute unified/split diffs in `agent-tracker.mjs` using pure JavaScript string comparison, formatting clean DaisyUI diff containers (`<div class="diff">` or `<pre class="text-xs">` with green/red line highlights) sent as HTML fragments.
- **Rationale**: Zero client dependency needed; Datastar morphs the diff fragment directly into the tool card DOM.
- **Alternatives Considered**: Loading heavy Monaco Editor or GitDiff.js (adds 1MB+ JS payload and slows down initial load).

### Decision 3: Hierarchical Agent State Machine
- **Choice**: Maintain a tree in `SessionState` where each agent has an ID, `parentAgentId`, `role`, `status` (`thinking`, `tool_call`, `waiting_user`, `idle`, `error`), and token metrics.
- **Rationale**: Agents run concurrently or spawn child subagents (e.g., `research`, `self`, `image-generator`). Flattening them into a single chronological feed confuses users. Tree-based swimlanes let users view the whole team at a glance.

## Risks / Trade-offs
- **[Risk] File locking or incomplete JSON lines during high-speed writes**:
  - *Mitigation*: The tailer buffers un-terminated lines until the next newline `\n` character before passing to `JSON.parse`.
- **[Risk] Long-running sessions filling browser memory**:
  - *Mitigation*: Feed fragments use a rolling window in Datastar (e.g. keeping the most recent 50 tool calls and thoughts in DOM, with full history available via download or scrollback archive).
- **[Risk] Browser tab background throttling**:
  - *Mitigation*: Web Audio API synthetic beeps bypass DOM timer throttling to reliably alert users when their attention is required.

specs/agent-tracker/spec.md:
# Spec Delta

## Purpose
Provides comprehensive real-time multi-agent activity monitoring, live transcript tailing, interactive tool execution inspection with visual diffs, subagent swarm hierarchy tracking, and context/token telemetry dashboard.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Live Transcript Tailing Daemon
The agent tracker system SHALL provide a file-watching daemon (`agent-tracker.mjs`) that automatically locates and tails active agent conversation transcripts (`transcript.jsonl` and `transcript_full.jsonl`), parsing events in real time and streaming updates via SSE.

#### Scenario: Auto-detecting and streaming active conversation steps
- **GIVEN** an agent executing tasks in a workspace
- **WHEN** the agent writes new steps (`USER_INPUT`, `PLANNER_RESPONSE`, `thinking`, or `tool_calls`) to `transcript.jsonl`
- **THEN** the tailing daemon MUST parse each step, extract reasoning and tool calls, and push Datastar SSE fragments to `/__datastar_stream__` with sub-100ms latency.

---

### Requirement: Multi-Agent Swarm & Subagent Hierarchy Visualizer
The dashboard SHALL provide a multi-agent hierarchy view representing orchestrator agents and subagents spawned via `invoke_subagent`, displaying agent roles, live states, and parent-child delegation links.

#### Scenario: Subagent invocation visualization
- **GIVEN** a running orchestrator agent session
- **WHEN** the orchestrator invokes a subagent via `invoke_subagent`
- **THEN** the dashboard MUST render a nested subagent card within `#agent-swarm-hierarchy` showing its `TypeName`, `Role`, live execution status badge, and dedicated thought/tool feed.

---

### Requirement: Interactive Tool Execution & Live Code Diff Inspector
The dashboard SHALL render rich tool execution cards featuring live elapsed execution stopwatches, ANSI-highlighted terminal drawers, and side-by-side or unified diff previews for file modification tools (`edit_file`, `write_file`).

#### Scenario: Live code diff inspection
- **GIVEN** an active tool invocation for `edit_file` or `write_file`
- **WHEN** the event is received with Target and Replacement text
- **THEN** the tool card MUST render a syntax-highlighted diff view highlighting additions and removals with line numbers.

---

### Requirement: Context Window & Token Velocity Telemetry
The dashboard SHALL provide real-time telemetry gauges displaying context window saturation percentage, token velocity (tokens/sec), and breakdown across prompt, reasoning, and completion tokens.

#### Scenario: Real-time context saturation gauge
- **GIVEN** an active agent session streaming telemetry
- **WHEN** token usage updates are received
- **THEN** the dashboard MUST update the context saturation radial gauge and token breakdown counters without full-page reloads.

---

### Requirement: Human-in-the-Loop Attention & Status Alerts
The dashboard SHALL provide configurable audio and visual alerts when an agent transitions into a state requiring human attention (`Waiting on User` or `Error`), along with thread-level filtering controls.

#### Scenario: Alert on user input required
- **GIVEN** the dashboard is open in the browser
- **WHEN** an agent issues an `ask_question` tool call or enters an idle state waiting for user response
- **THEN** the dashboard MUST display a prominent amber attention badge and trigger an optional chime sound.
specs/live-llm-tracking/spec.md:
# Spec Delta

## MODIFIED Requirements

### Requirement: Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard
The report MUST provide real-time hypermedia tracking components powered by Datastar.js and SSE (`/__datastar_stream__`) displaying LLM thoughts, tool calls, subagent activity, and task progress with live fragment morphing.

#### Scenario: Live Chain-of-Thought Stream
- **GIVEN** an active Datastar stream connection
- **WHEN** an agent emits a thought delta event
- **THEN** Datastar MUST append or morph the thought into `#agent-thought-stream` without page reload.

#### Scenario: Live Tool Invocation & Terminal Output
- **GIVEN** an active Datastar stream connection
- **WHEN** a tool call event is received
- **THEN** Datastar MUST prepend a tool invocation card to `#tool-call-feed` displaying tool name, arguments, status indicator, and collapsible terminal output drawer.

#### Scenario: Real-Time Task Card Morphing
- **GIVEN** a task item `#task-${id}` in the dashboard
- **WHEN** the server broadcasts a `datastar-fragment` with `selector: #task-${id}` and updated status
- **THEN** Datastar MUST morph the task card in-place, updating the status badge, checkbox, and completion state.

#### Scenario: Subagent Swarm Stream Routing
- **GIVEN** an active Datastar stream connection
- **WHEN** a subagent event is broadcast with a target conversation ID or subagent name
- **THEN** Datastar MUST route and morph the subagent fragment into the appropriate thread in `#agent-swarm-hierarchy`.
